title: Intramolecular nuclear dynamics in intermolecular Coulombic electron capture
summary: We present an analytical model for intermolecular Coulombic electron capture (ICEC) which includes the internal nuclear dynamics of the molecules involved. In ICEC, an electron attaches to an atom or molecule by transferring excess energy to a neighbor, ionizing said neighbor. While previous theoretical investigations assumed fixed nuclei, recent studies indicate that relative motion between the two ICEC partners significantly influences the process.
